name: Cheech & Chong - 1g Cart - Rose Bubly (S)
description:
Light, bright, and a little celebratory. The Cheech & Chong Rose Bubly cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Rose Bubly pours on a crisp, effervescent profile: sweet berry and rosé-style fruit up front with soft floral notes and a clean, bubbly finish. Blended with a sativa terpene profile for an uplifting, energizing feel — bright and social, made for daytime and good company.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Rose Bubly flavor — sweet berry and floral notes with a crisp, bubbly finish
Sativa terpene blend — uplifting and energizing, ideal for daytime
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Bright flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Cheech & Chong Rose Bubly is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
